question: What is the main purpose of electronic communication in nursing?

options.A: Exchanging health data and care details using digital tools
options.B: Replacing all face-to-face contact between staff and patients
options.C: Eliminating the need for any written patient records
options.D: Speeding up personal social media chats during shift hours

explanation: Electronic communication uses digital devices to quickly share patient and administrative information across healthcare teams. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: Why are digital health records generally safer than traditional paper notes?

options.A: They allow patients to change their own treatment plans online
options.B: They remove the need for nurses to document care procedures
options.C: They are completely immune to technical errors or system failures
options.D: They prevent the risk of unreadable handwriting and lost notes

explanation: Digital entries are clear, typed, and easily accessible across shifts, solving the problem of poor handwriting and misplaced paper charts. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: When is an individual digital message most appropriate in a clinical setting?

options.A: For posting general holiday notices on a public forum
options.B: For broadcasting emergency drills to the whole hospital
options.C: For publishing weekly hospital menus to the general public
options.D: For sharing quick, specific updates about a single patient

explanation: One-on-one digital messages are ideal for targeted, rapid communication regarding a specific patient's immediate needs. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: A nurse needs to inform the shift team about a new hospital policy change. What is the best way to use group communication for this?

options.A: Send a secure group message or email to all staff members on the ward
options.B: Write the policy on a random patient whiteboard in the main hallway
options.C: Share the details on a personal social media account without privacy filters
options.D: Call every single staff member individually during their busy morning rounds

explanation: Group messaging allows charge nurses to efficiently broadcast general updates and policy changes to an entire team at once. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: What is a major benefit of using video conferencing for patient follow-up care?

options.A: It bridges geographical gaps for patients in remote areas
options.B: It completely replaces the need for any in-person hospital visits
options.C: It removes all requirements for patient data privacy protection
options.D: It allows nurses to physically change dressings from miles away

explanation: Video tools allow nurses to assess and support patients who live far away without requiring them to travel to the facility. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: Why is a quiet, private environment essential when a nurse conducts a telehealth video call?

options.A: To make the nurse's computer battery last much longer during the shift
options.B: To stop other staff members from asking questions about their work
options.C: To ensure compliance with patient privacy and confidentiality laws
options.D: To prevent background noise from interrupting the internet signal

explanation: Conducting calls in private spaces stops unauthorized people from overhearing sensitive health discussions, protecting patient confidentiality. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: Which collaborative platform is most commonly integrated directly into secure hospital software systems?
explanation: Microsoft Teams is built to integrate smoothly with enterprise healthcare software for secure internal communication and file sharing. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: Why do nursing educators often use platforms like Zoom or Google Meet?

options.A: To automatically administer and grade physical injections
options.B: To replace clinical bedside practice with computer games
options.C: To track the exact physical location of nursing students on duty
options.D: To hold virtual classes, webinars, and multidisciplinary huddles

explanation: These video platforms allow educators to connect with large groups of students or staff for lectures, training, and team meetings. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: What is the primary function of a learning management system like Moodle in nursing?

options.A: To monitor patient heart rates in the intensive care unit
options.B: To act as a digital classroom for coursework and staff training
options.C: To send emergency billing alerts to hospital insurance companies
options.D: To replace electronic health record charting at the bedside

explanation: Platforms like Moodle are educational portals used to host learning materials, assignments, and professional development modules. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: How do learning management systems particularly benefit nurses who work rotating shift duties?

options.A: By allowing them to complete mandatory training modules at their own convenience
options.B: By exempting them from all practical hospital exams and clinical hours
options.C: By providing free mobile phones for personal communication use
options.D: By automatically writing their patient care notes during night shifts

explanation: Because these platforms are available online around the clock, nurses can fit their continuing education around irregular shift schedules. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: What action should a nurse take immediately before leaving a computer workstation on the ward?

options.A: Lock or log out of the workstation to prevent unauthorized access
options.B: Minimize the patient charts without locking the screen
options.C: Turn off the main electrical power switch in the room
options.D: Leave the screen open for the next shift nurse

explanation: Locking unattended screens prevents unauthorized people from viewing confidential patient health records. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)

question: Which of the following practices is NOT permitted when handling electronic patient information?

options.A: Sending identifiable patient records through unsecured personal messaging apps
options.B: Locking computer screens when walking away from a hospital workstation
options.C: Verifying the recipient's identity before sending clinical notes
options.D: Using end-to-end encrypted software for telehealth discussions

explanation: Unsecured personal apps lack proper encryption and violate patient privacy laws, making them unsafe for sharing identifiable health data. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h6)
